Taking RAN4#116 meeting as an example, in total, 3176 contributions are uploaded. Among them, about 1800 documents are CR/pCR/ darft CR, which more than 50% of the total number of Tdocs. This is the typical case at the end of a WI. Large number of CRs are sent out for review during the final days of meeting. Due to lack of time for careful check, many typos and errors are introduced to the specification, which also increase the burden of maintaining the specifications. Many issues are identified for CR drafting and review, including limited time for drafting CR due to late agreements in the meeting week, no sufficient time for CR review, etc. In RAN4#116 meeting, in total, 3176 contributions are uploaded. Large number of CRs are sent out for review during the final days of meeting. Due to lack of time for careful check, many typos and errors are introduced to the specification, which also increase the burden of maintaining the specifications. To solve the issue, following list the candidate solutions for CR handling, which can be used as starting point to discuss the CR handling Adopt running CR approach as in RAN1/2 Appoint big CR editor/section editor Proposal 1: for CR handling, it is proposed to consider following options Adopt running CR approach as in RAN1/2 Appoint big CR editor/section editor This contribution provides discussion on CR handling for RAN4 operation efficiency. The proposals are: Proposal 1: for CR handling, it is proposed to consider following options Adopt running CR approach as in RAN1/2 Appoint big CR editor/section editor RP-251881, New SID: Study on 6G Radio R4-2511652, RAN4 6G Plan and Meeting Arrangement R4-2514648, Way Forward for [116bis][111] 6G operation efficiency, CATT
